本义解释JSON: Mental activity, an inner state, or a way of thinking; the examples refer to a person's mindset.
The function or effect something has, or the role it plays in an event.
To affect other people with an emotion, attitude, or spirit so that they share the feeling; this is the figurative sense in these examples.
To start doing something personally; it can also mean using physical force or hitting someone.
To engage in a kind of work or take part in an activity.
The resources or money currently at hand; it can also describe a person's present financial situation.
To operate or run, as a machine, program, or transport service does.
To carry something on the back. The ongoing-state marker ZHE follows the verb; this is an action phrase, not an utterance particle.
The outline, shape, or posture of a person's body.
To learn something well or reach a good level of skill; HAO marks a successful result here.
One round or cycle. LUN also counts round objects, such as the moon.
Not clear or not understood. After a verb, it can express an inability to make something clear.
Clear and bright, describing eyes, or clear and ringing, describing a voice.
To use something up, or to finish one use of an item.
